senses.gloss: m. (חלף) a species of rush (so named from its sharp edges, v. Fl. to Levy Targ. Dict. I, 4251, a. Sm. Ant. s. v. Schoenus).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 1:10">Tosef. Succ. I, 10</cite> <he>של קנים ושל ח׳</he> (a matting) of reeds or rushes; <cite ref="Sukkah 20a:1">Succ. 20ᵃ</cite> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="H00793"><he>חילת</he></cite>, Ms. M. <cite ref="H00354"><he>חולית</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:17">Kel. XVII, 17</cite>.—[Pl. <cite ref="H00786"><he>חִילְפִין</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="H01058"><he>חֲלִיפִין</he></cite> a. <cite ref="H00780"><he>חֵלֶף</he></cite>.]
